title: An Effect starts and stops, again and again

slides.say: Components mount, update and unmount. Effects do not. An Effect can only start synchronizing, and later stop.
Follow one chat room Effect while the component stays on screen.

steps.say: It starts by connecting to the general room.
The user picks travel. The Effect stops, disconnecting general, then starts again with travel.
Same thing for music. Still the same mounted component.
Only when the screen closes does it stop for the last time.

slides.text: Body = how to start. Cleanup = how to stop. React calls them as often as needed.
slides.say: The Effect body says how to start. The cleanup says how to stop. React calls them in order, as many times as the data requires.
